name: zc_territories

tests.name: every territory in the registry is loaded
every specialisation shown is the canon's own word, and the canon's silence is marked

detail.note: read out of WorldDesign/CANON/nations.json in this proof. The founder: 'DO NOT INVENT THE TERRITORY SPECIALIZATIONS ... mark it as NEEDS FOUNDER DEFINITION rather than silently inventing permanent lore.'

tests.name: the territories the canon does not define are named, not guessed at

detail.note: DUBEL FOREST. nations.json gives it an existence and an exception rule and states no discipline; the panel and the banner both read NEEDS FOUNDER DEFINITION for it.

tests.name: a checkpoint marker is standing for every territory
the markers are architecture, not floating pins

detail.note: the founder: 'Do NOT use generic floating map pins.' Six metres of standing stone, on the ground, at the scale of a gatepost.

tests.name: a player who has been nowhere has discovered nothing

detail.note: taken from a spot outside every territory's radius; standing in one and calling it undiscovered would be measuring the proof rather than the world

tests.name: standing in a territory is recognised, for every territory
every territory is DISCOVERED by walking into it, and none before
the first-entry banner names the territory it was raised for
the banner's second line is the canon's word, or the fact that there is none
the world map carries every territory

detail.note: the founder asked for this inside the existing navigation UI rather than beside it

tests.name: selecting a territory shows name, specialisation, state, purpose, places, activities and the way there
the map says which way every territory lies and how far

way.golden_arrival: GOLDEN ARRIVAL lies west, 1275 m away.
way.dubel: You are standing in DUBEL FOREST.

detail.note: the founder: 'Where is ICARUS? Where is NOCTIS? Where is TARTARUS? ... How do I get there?'

tests.name: every territory walked into is still discovered at the end of the walk
